notes: Reward assets are tokenized US stocks: bStocks issued by BTECH Holdings Ltd (a Binance
group affiliate, ADGM-regulated), each backed 1:1 by a share held in custody.
Every entry is added with scripts/add-token.mjs, which checks, for each token:
1. The DexScreener link resolves to the pool's base token, and liquidity is summed over every BSC pool
2. name(), symbol(), decimals() and totalSupply() read directly from BNB Smart Chain
3. The bytecode delegates to the bStocks issuer beacon (0x156d6dce9a4f6139a3406f1f021f1a4880de93a3) — a copycat ticker cannot fake this
bStock balances rebase for dividends and splits, and the issuer can block addresses. bStocks
must not be offered to US persons (Regulation S); integrators are required to geo-block.
Identity is the address in every lookup — there is deliberately no resolve-by-ticker path.
Logos identify the token a reward consists of and remain the marks of their owners. See data/image-credits.json.
